schema_note: Enriched card merging the original retrodiction card, the parameter/ad-hoc audit, the four-skeptic adversarial panel, and the Repair-Agent + Fertility-Judge output (repair + 0-5 scores + triage). Written by the Repair Agent for R002.

original_card.one_sentence_claim: In an explicit system-apparatus-environment qubit measurement, "macroscopic definiteness" is layer-relative objecthood: the global SAE state stays pure (entangled) under unitary dynamics while the record-level state obtained by discarding/dephasing in the pointer basis is an exactly idempotent classical mixture over pointer outcomes, so Schroedinger's-cat "alive-vs-dead superposition" is dissolved as a category mistake (treating substrate amplitudes as object-level facts before a record is packaged), not by any new physics.
original_card.target_known_fact: The standard decoherence account of apparent collapse (Zurek; Joos-Zeh; Nielsen-Chuang Lueders pinching): tracing out the environment / dephasing the apparatus pointer yields a classical mixture at the apparatus level whose diagonal entries are the Born weights, while the global SAE state remains unitary and (in the closed-system idealization) pure and entangled; no macroscopic superposition is ever observed because the apparatus-level description is record-diagonal.
original_card.scientific_domain: Quantum foundations / macroscopic superposition / quantum-to-classical transition / measurement problem

theory_basis.component: P5 packaging endomap E with Fix(E)=objects (idempotent closure); section axiom Q_f(U_f nu)=nu => E_f=U_f Q_f idempotent; P5 = quotient/packaging map induced by an equivalence, idempotent by construction
theory_basis.role: Supplies the closure primitive: 'collapse'/record-formation is the once-and-done action of an idempotent packaging map, and objects at a layer are its fixed points. Grounds idempotence error = 0.

theory_basis.component: OI-EI principle (empirically indiscernible at a layer => identical objects at that layer) + Leibniz-quotient example (lens reading only z_1 has exactly two objects)
theory_basis.role: Supplies the layer-relative objecthood that does the actual dissolving: 'alive vs dead' is only an object-level distinction once the pointer-record distinction is packaged; demanding it earlier is surplus structure (the category mistake).

theory_basis.component: EXP-CAT1 S-A-E qubit model: CNOT U_SA correlates S with pointer, then dephase/discard; diagnostics global purity Tr(rho_SAE^2)=1, local purity Tr(rho_SA^2)=0.5, dist(packaged, pointer mixture)=1.11e-16, idempotence error=0
theory_basis.role: The concrete numerical demonstration (Section sec:cat, Table tab:cat-metrics). Pack(rho_SA)=Delta_A(rho_SA) is a nonselective record update; conditioning (single outcome) is held separate.

theory_basis.component: thm:dephase: Delta(rho)=sum_i Pi_i rho Pi_i is idempotent with fixed points exactly the diagonal (record-classical) states (Lean dephase_idem, dephase_fixed_iff_exists_diagonal)
theory_basis.role: The PROVED + Lean-certified backbone guaranteeing the packaging map is a genuine idempotent closure whose fixed-point set is the classical mixtures, so the packaged cat state is forced to be record-diagonal.

theory_basis.component: Route mismatch RM_d(E,F;rho)=d(EFrho,FErho); U_tau and Delta commute iff H record-diagonal (max generic ~0.350099, diagonal H ~0)
theory_basis.role: Optional strengthening hook: locates why a coherent (off-diagonal) substrate description and a record-diagonal packaged description are genuinely distinct routes, not the same object.

original_card.minimum_viable_result: Restate EXP-CAT1 as a clean conditional proposition: GIVEN the pointer basis as a record lens and standard QM substrate (unitary + partial trace), the global SAE state can remain pure while the packaged record state is an exactly idempotent classical mixture in Fix(Pack); hence by OI-EI no record-layer object is a macroscopic superposition.
original_card.baseline_comparison: SBT does NOT do better than the standard account on physics content -- it merely RECOVERS it. The global-pure/local-mixed split is the elementary partial-trace identity for a maximally-entangled (Bell-like) post-CNOT state, and the classical-mixture-at-the-apparatus step is textbook Lueders pinching / nonselective measurement (Nielsen-Chuang), i.e. Zurek/Joos-Zeh decoherence reproduced numerically in a qubit toy. What is genuinely REORGANIZED (not new physics) is the conceptual framing: 'macroscopic definiteness' is recast as layer-relative objecthood = membership in Fix of an idempotent P5 record closure, with the idempotence/fixed-point backbone (thm:dephase) Lean-certified, and the paradox dissolved by OI-EI rather than by collapse dynamics.

original_card.recommended_artifact: A short conditional-proposition note ('Macroscopic definiteness as layer-relative objecthood') that (a) restates EXP-CAT1 as the minimum-viable proposition, (b) cites the Lean-certified thm:dephase backbone, (c) states and proves the moderate OI-EI lemma and the general finite-dim theorem (stronger version), and (d) explicitly quarantines single-outcome and pointer-basis selection.
original_card.honest_status_note: B-class paradox-resolution that RECOVERS standard decoherence, not new physics; candidate prose slightly overstates two things relative to the certified record: (1) global purity is exactly 1, not 'near-pure'; (2) the cat diagnostics are NUMERICAL regression certificates in a single qubit toy, NOT mechanized theorems -- only the abstract dephasing-closure backbone (dephase_idem, dephase_fixed_iff_exists_diagonal) is Lean-certified. The two hardest parts of the measurement problem (single-outcome selection; pointer-basis selection) are explicitly NOT addressed. Born weights imported, not derived.

audit_summary.audit_verdict: LOW overfitting risk, but ZERO novel-prediction content -- honest recovery/reorganization, not a derivation. ~8 adjustable choices vs 4 reported numbers that collapse to ~2 independent facts (one partial-trace identity giving global=1/local=0.5; one Lueders-pinching identity giving dist~0/idem-error=0). Every matched number is an exact algebraic identity forced by imported standard QM, so there is nothing to overfit and seed-robustness is vacuous. Disclaimers (Born rule, pointer-basis/einselection, single-outcome collapse) are RESPECTED; the two hard cores are honestly quarantined. Opposite-world: SBT could retrodict any handed-in pointer basis (basis is a free input), so the claim is only defensible conditional-on-basis; it could NOT manufacture a persistent macroscopic-superposition object because Fix(Pack) is diagonal by construction (not earned). Mechanism reuse is genuine (idempotent-packaging P5 shared with R001; route-mismatch hook shared with R006).

opposite_world_test.explanation: Because the pointer basis is a FREE externally-supplied input (missing_interfaces[0]; disclaimer line 856), SBT reproduces an exactly-diagonal classical mixture in WHICHEVER basis it is handed (the EXP-QE1 eraser move conditions in {|+>,|->}). It thus retrodicts whichever basis nature supplies -> claim must be stated conditional-on-basis. It CANNOT produce a persistent macroscopic-superposition object, since Fix(Pack) is diagonal by construction -- but that exclusion is definitional, not an earned prediction (a constant/projection map has idempotence defect 0 and does not certify emergence).

Unanimous diagnosis: faithful RELABELING of textbook decoherence; thm:dephase IS Lueders pinching; the four cat numbers are exact algebraic identities; the dissolution is carried by OI-EI (an adopted methodological principle) plus the definitional identification objecthood=Fix(Pack), not by any proved quantum lemma.

The two hard cores (single-outcome selection; pointer-basis/einselection selection) are QUARANTINED BY FIAT.
The cat numbers are NUMERICAL regression certificates, not mechanized theorems; only the abstract dephasing backbone + Leibniz quotient are Lean-certified.
'No macroscopic-superposition object' is BUILT INTO the construction (Fix(Pack) diagonal by definition), not earned.

skeptic_panel_summary.what_would_change_their_mind: Either (a) a derivation crossing a quarantined line (a canonical-lens/einselection principle selecting the pointer basis from dynamics, or a single-outcome-selection mechanism, or a Born-weight measure principle -- all explicitly disclaimed missing), or (b) a genuinely novel basis-independent prediction distinguishing this from textbook decoherence (none exists). Short of that, the maximum credit is the written general finite-dim theorem + the OI-EI off-diagonal-silence lemma (proved on the operator algebra), which firms up the reorganization to a clean ad-hoc-free structural proposition -- still a recovery, consistent with a mid score, not high.

FORBIDDEN moves avoided: no new tuning, no hidden assumptions, no concealment of imported physics, no claimed uniqueness of the lift/basis, no 'naturally emerges'.
repair.revised_one_sentence_claim: Conditional on a fixed pointer basis as the record lens and on standard QM (unitary substrate + partial trace + Lueders pinching + imported Born weights), the explicit EXP-CAT1 S-A-E qubit model is an exact instance of decoherence reorganized as SBT P5 layer-relative objecthood: the global SAE state is exactly pure (a closed-system CNOT-on-pure-product artifact, Tr rho_SAE^2 = 1) and entangled while the discard+dephase record state is an exactly idempotent classical mixture in Fix(Pack) (idempotence error 0; dist-to-mixture ~1.11e-16, Lean-certified backbone thm:dephase), so 'alive-vs-dead' is not a record-layer object -- a recovery of standard decoherence plus an OI-EI category-mistake diagnosis, NOT new physics, with single-outcome selection, pointer-basis (einselection) selection, and the Born rule explicitly quarantined as underived external interfaces.
repair.new_minimum_viable_result: An honest conditional-proposition note with an explicit, statused lemma chain. (L1, PROVED+Lean) Delta_A is idempotent. (L2, PROVED+Lean) Fix(Delta_A) = pointer-diagonal states. (L3, NUMERICAL regression certificate, single qubit toy) EXP-CAT1: Tr rho_SAE^2 = 1 exactly, Tr rho_SA^2 = 0.5, dist(Pack(rho_SA), pointer mixture) = 1.11e-16, idempotence error = 0 -- all exact algebraic identities of unitary + partial trace + Lueders pinching. (L4, REQUIRED-but-UNWRITTEN, moderate) the operator-algebra OI-EI lemma: the pointer-basis definability algebra cannot separate rho_SA from Delta_A(rho_SA), so they are one record-layer object -- this is the load-bearing step and must be PROVED on density operators, not borrowed from the classical {Bool}x{Bool} thm:leibniz-quotient. (L5, IMPORTED) diagonal entries = Born weights |alpha|^2,|beta|^2. (L6, OPTIONAL-UNWRITTEN, moderate) general finite-dim version over the declared deterministic-lens class. Deliverable framed strictly as a REORGANIZATION/RECOVERY of decoherence with zero predictive content; if L4/L6 stall, fall back to L1-L3+L5 as a conditional restatement and flag L4 as the open formal gap.

score_rationale.impact: 3. The measurement problem and Schroedinger's cat are the highest-profile puzzles in quantum foundations, so a clean, auditable, Lean-anchored reorganizing language has genuine pedagogical/conceptual interest. Capped at 3 because it adds no predictive content and recovers a 40-year-old standard account.
score_rationale.execution_ease: 5. Backbone (thm:dephase) already proved + Lean-certified; EXP-CAT1 deterministic and already runnable (python -m sbtq.run_all --seed 0); global-pure/local-mixed is a one-line partial-trace identity. Only genuinely new work is the moderate L4 lemma and optional L6 theorem -- a few days of write-up, no new machinery.
score_rationale.plausibility: 5. Every quantitative claim is an exact algebraic identity of standard QM (unitary + partial trace + Lueders pinching); nothing physically contestable. The numbers are forced, not fitted.
score_rationale.non_ad_hocness: 4. Low overfitting (DOF >> independent data but the 'fit' is identities, not a fit); mechanism reuse genuine (idempotent-packaging P5 shared with R001; route-mismatch with R006); disclaimers respected; quarantine is honest. Held below 5 because the load-bearing dissolution rides on an ADOPTED methodological principle (OI-EI) plus a definitional identification objecthood=Fix(Pack), and the basis is a free input -- so the resolution is partly a convention, not fully forced.
score_rationale.discriminative_power: 1. Essentially none. The opposite-world test passes for basis selection (any handed-in pointer basis is reproduced), and the only thing structurally excluded (a persistent macroscopic-superposition object) is excluded by construction, not by an earned prediction. No observation could distinguish this from textbook decoherence.
score_rationale.audience_legibility: 4. The Spekkens/Leibniz framing, the Fix(Pack) characterization, and the Lean-certified backbone are clear and well-targeted to foundations/quantum-info/philosophy-of-physics/formal-methods audiences. Slightly below 5 because the contribution's true scope (recovery, not derivation) is easy for a casual reader to over-read, and 'Lean-anchored cat resolution' invites over-impression.
score_rationale.precision: 3. The repaired claim is sharply stated and conditional, with exact certified numbers. Capped at 3 because SBT's own disclaimers bound it: the Born rule, pointer basis, and single-outcome selection are underived, so the 'resolution' is precise only on the easy (definitional) half and silent on the half that motivates the paradox.
score_rationale.robustness: 4. Numerically robust across seeds 0-9 (identical values) and basis-independent in the sense that the same machinery applies in any chosen basis. But the robustness is the trivial robustness of exact identities, so it carries no confirmatory weight; held at 4 not 5 because the exact-purity-1 result is an artifact of the closed-system/minimal-environment idealization rather than a generic SAE feature.
score_rationale.baseline_advantage: 1. Capped low by SBT's own disclaimers and the card's own admission ('does NOT do better ... merely RECOVERS it'). No advantage over standard decoherence on physics; adds only bookkeeping discipline and a fixed-point characterization. Not 0 because the explicit causal-substrate-vs-inferential-packaging separation plus the Lean-certified Fix(Pack) characterization is a marginally cleaner formal restatement.
score_rationale.publication_potential: 2. As-is, recovery-only with no new physics -> hard to place as a research result; fits a foundations/philosophy-of-physics venue or a formal-methods note ONLY if framed honestly as a reorganization + a newly-proved L4 operator-algebra lemma + the L6 general theorem. Without L4/L6 it is a worked-example note, not a paper. Held at 2 because the novel formal content is thin and the headline is a known result.

recommended_priority: Low-to-medium. Pursue only as a cheap conceptual-reframing note IF the moderate L4 operator-algebra OI-EI lemma and the L6 general finite-dim theorem are actually written; otherwise shelve as a worked example. Best value is as a unifying-lens companion to R001 (collapse-as-dephasing) and R006 (contextuality-as-route-mismatch), demonstrating cross-phenomenon compression of the idempotent-packaging P5 primitive.
one_line_verdict: Honest, low-cost, ad-hoc-free reorganization of textbook decoherence as P5 layer-relative objecthood (Fix of an idempotent record closure) with a Lean-certified backbone -- but pure recovery with zero predictive content, the real dissolving work done by an adopted OI-EI principle whose load-bearing operator-algebra lemma is still unwritten; survives at survival=3, best filed as a conceptual reframing (bin E) conditional-on-basis and conditional-on-standard-QM.
